name: issue-triage
description: Triage new and reopened GitHub issues: resolve scope from repo evidence, apply priority and ready-for-dev labels, and write the managed acceptance-criteria section.

repos.description: Repositories whose issues are triaged. Each entry is owner/repo.

github_token_secret.description: Name of the stored secret holding the GitHub token used for reads, labels, and body updates.

base_branch.description: Branch to read repository guidance from. Defaults to each repository's default branch.

suggested_trigger.filter: contains(['OpenHands/extensions', 'OpenHands/OpenHands', 'OpenHands/software-agent-sdk', 'OpenHands/automation', 'OpenHands/enterprise', 'OpenHands/saas-deploy', 'OpenHands/evaluation'], repository.full_name) && contains(keys(@), 'issue') && !contains(keys(@), 'comment') && (contains(['opened','reopened'], action) || (action == 'unlabeled' && label.name == 'ready-for-dev' && sender.login != 'github-actions[bot]'))
